# 💳 gws Sheets Read

💳 Requires a paid Google Workspace account for the gws CLI — no free tier. Curated by Skill Harbor — the Sheets-read module of the gws CLI: read values from a spreadsheet (`gws sheets +read --spreadsheet <ID> --range <RANGE>`) with documented flags. Distinct from the already-listed gws-sheets: this is the focused read-values subcommand, same format as the other gws subcommand listings. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: read-only and spreadsheet-scoped — for writes or other Sheets operations use the sibling gws modules; the shared auth/security rules live in a separate gws-shared skill the agent must read first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
